road_disruptions.comments: [A40] Westway (Eastbound) at the junction of [A3220] West Cross Route - The exit slip road to the Northern Roundabout is closed to facilitate repair works.
[A219] Wood Lane (Both directions) between [A40] Westway and South Africa Road - Various carriageway and footway restrictions in place to facilitate Cycle Superhighway works.
[A4000] Station Road (All directions) at the junction of [A4000] Old Oak Lane - Temporary signals in place due to Thames Water works.
[A219] Wood Lane (Southbound) at the junction of Bulwer Street - Between 27th April and 3rd December 2026, there is a bus stop suspension.

[A219] Wood Lane (Northbound) between Ariel Way and Macfarlane Road - There is a northbound lane closure between Macfarlane Road and Ariel Way from 27th May 2026 to 12th October 2026 to facilitate cycleway works.
[A219] Wood Lane (Southbound) between South Africa Road and Fountain Park Way - There is a southbound lane closure to facilitate cycleway works.
[A219] Wood Lane (Both directions) between A40 Westway and Du Cane Road - Various lane restrictions in place to facilitate TfL works.
[A404] Harrow Road (All approaches) at the junction of Marylands Road - Temporary traffic signals in use to facilitate UKPN works.
[B413] Kilburn Lane (Both directions) at the junction of Herries Street - The road is closed for emergency Thames Water works.
[A402] Notting Hill Gate (Westbound) at the junction of Pembridge Gardens - Lane one (of three) is closed to facilitate emergency Thames Water works.
[A4207] Great Western Road (Northbound) at the junction of Hormead Road - Temporary traffic signals are in operation to facilitate Thames Water works.
